title: RAKL pre-action fibre receipt v1
description: Proposal-only, content-bound record of a research action selection frozen before the action executes. It binds the exact problem fibre snapshot, the retrievals selected and relevant-but-rejected with their authority, the chosen operator, and the predeclared discriminator with its allowed outcome branches. It does not claim the fibre search universe was complete, does not establish wall-clock priority, and mints no proof, lesson, tool, gluing, theorem, review-independence or framework authority.

application_revision.description: Exact application commit or tree identity. Not constrained to a git OID so that a tree hash or content-addressed revision may be bound.

fibre_snapshot_hash.description: Exact ProblemFibre.snapshot_hash the action was selected against.

predeclared_discriminator.description: The falsifier or discriminator declared before the action ran.

allowed_outcome_branches.description: Every outcome the agent was prepared to accept before seeing the result. An observed branch outside this list is a discriminator substitution, not a surprise.

timestamp.description: UTC ISO-8601 selection time. Internal ordering only; see establishes_wall_clock_priority.

sequence_index.description: The agent's declared position in its own action sequence, bound into the content hash so a later reordering of receipts is detectable. Ordering against an episode is done on timestamp; TaskEpisode carries no sequence number.

public_trace_event_id.description: Anchor in the append-only public research trace. Tamper-evidence derives from this anchor, not from the timestamp string.

declared_consequence.description: The agent's own classification. It is a claim under test, not a fact; UNCLASSIFIED fails closed to CONSEQUENTIAL.

rejection_reason.description: Mandatory for a rejected retrieval, null for a selected one. An unexplained rejection is indistinguishable from an omission.

authority_bearing_retrieval_ids.description: Subset of selected retrievals the agent claims supplies authority. Every member must be SELECTED and CANONICAL.

coverage_receipt_id.description: Optional pointer to a separate retrieval-universe coverage receipt. Its absence is reported, never silently treated as coverage.

claims_fibre_search_universe_complete.description: Permanently false. Retrieval-universe coverage is a separate object.

establishes_wall_clock_priority.description: Permanently false. The timestamp is a string the agent writes; ordering here is internal consistency only.
